name: youtube-watcher
description: Fetch and read transcripts from YouTube videos. Use to summarize a video, answer questions about its content, or extract information from it. Also lists available caption languages and looks up basic video info (title, channel). Falls back to yt-dlp when YouTube blocks automated transcript requests, and supports an optional proxy.
author: Buildersoft LLC

tools.name: youtube.get_transcript
tools.description: Fetch the transcript of a YouTube video as plain text (default) or timed segments. Accepts a video ID or any YouTube URL. Optionally translate the transcript to another language.

video.description: YouTube video ID or URL (watch, youtu.be, shorts, embed)

languages.description: Preferred caption language codes in priority order (default ["en"]); falls back to any available transcript

format.description: "text" = one joined string (default); "segments" = list of {text, start, duration}

translateTo.description: Optional target language code (e.g. "es") to translate the transcript into

proxy.description: Optional HTTP(S) proxy URL ("http://user:pass@host:port") to route transcript requests through when YouTube blocks the current IP; ideally a rotating residential proxy

tools.name: youtube.list_transcripts
tools.description: List the caption tracks available for a video (language, whether auto-generated, and whether translatable).

proxy.description: Optional HTTP(S) proxy URL to route the request through when YouTube blocks the current IP

tools.name: youtube.get_video_info
tools.description: Look up basic public metadata for a video (title, channel/author, thumbnail) via YouTube's keyless oEmbed endpoint.
